informal_statement: For r > 0, 0 < theta < pi, positive natural N and any natural i, consecutive partition images have distance 2r sin(theta/N).
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. The length measure is Euclidean one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete frontier. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
